utterances.speaker: Nell

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey — that’ll help a lot. I’ve got the current list going, so just let me know when you spot anything extra.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Bo — that covers a lot. If you can grab any extra nails and a screwdriver set, that would be a big help, and I’ll keep both groups posted.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—I’ve got some old tools and a few spare screws you can pick up if needed.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, thanks, Bo — I’ll let the others know and swing by for the spare screws if we need them.

utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa — I’m still keeping it simple and just trying to gather a few more helpers. If you hear of anyone willing, send them my way.

utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Nell — I’m still gathering tools and spare parts for the repair drive. If you hear of anything usable, let me know and I can swing by to pick it up.
